calendar.description: Continuous elapsed time, including weekends and holidays. Demonstration only.

categories.title: Pothole
categories.description: A pothole on a public road creates a hazard for vehicles or pedestrians.
categories.example: Pothole filled with rainwater near the bus stop.

categories.title: Damaged road surface
categories.description: Broken asphalt, ruts, or loose road material need repair.
categories.example: Road surface has crumbled across the junction.

categories.title: Broken footpath
categories.description: Uneven or broken pavement blocks safe walking.
categories.example: Footpath tiles are broken beside the clinic.

categories.title: Open or damaged manhole
categories.description: A missing or unsafe manhole cover creates an urgent hazard.
categories.example: Manhole cover is missing near the school crossing.

categories.title: Missed waste collection
categories.description: Scheduled household waste has not been collected.
categories.example: Waste bags were not picked up on the usual collection day.

categories.title: Overflowing public bin
categories.description: A public waste bin is full and litter is spreading.
categories.example: Community bin is overflowing onto the footpath.

categories.title: Garbage dumping
categories.description: Waste has been dumped at a public place or roadside.
categories.example: Mixed waste has been dumped on the vacant roadside.

categories.title: Broken streetlight
categories.description: A public streetlight is not working after dark.
categories.example: Streetlight beside the lane has been off for three nights.

categories.title: Water pipe leak
categories.description: Water is leaking from a public supply pipe or valve.
categories.example: Water is flowing from a broken pipe near the pavement.

categories.title: No water supply
categories.description: A locality has lost its expected municipal water supply.
categories.example: No water reached the building taps since yesterday morning.

categories.title: Blocked stormwater drain
categories.description: A roadside drain is clogged and rainwater is pooling.
categories.example: Drain grate is blocked with silt and leaves after rainfall.

categories.title: Sewage overflow
categories.description: Wastewater is overflowing from a public sewer or drain.
categories.example: Wastewater is coming out of the roadside chamber.

categories.title: Road obstruction
categories.description: An obstruction on a public road prevents safe passage.
categories.example: Fallen material blocks one lane near the bus depot.

categories.title: Damaged speed breaker
categories.description: A broken or poorly marked speed breaker needs inspection.
categories.example: Broken speed breaker beside the school gate.

categories.title: Faded road markings
categories.description: Crossing or lane markings are worn and difficult to see.
categories.example: Zebra crossing has faded outside the clinic.

categories.title: Construction debris
categories.description: Construction rubble has been left on a public road or pavement.
categories.example: Rubble blocks the footpath outside a building site.

categories.title: Street cleaning needed
categories.description: Litter and accumulated dirt on a public street need removal.
categories.example: Leaves and litter cover the market walking path.

categories.title: Damaged public bin
categories.description: A public waste bin is broken or cannot contain waste.
categories.example: The bottom of the community waste bin is broken.

categories.title: Low water pressure
categories.description: Municipal water pressure is too low during the supply window.
categories.example: Taps receive a trickle during the scheduled morning supply.

categories.title: Damaged drain cover
categories.description: A public drain cover is broken, loose, or missing.
categories.example: Cracked drain cover beside the walking path.
